# TSLA close on 2026-09-17: research notes

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the TSLA daily close shown on Yahoo Finance for 2026-09-17, which is a Thursday and a normal trading day. My fetch of the Yahoo history page was refused by the proxy, so I could not read the value there directly. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/TSLA/history/)
- 2026-08-26: close $345.82 (open 345.27, high 351.93, low 342.53, down 1.26%, volume about 28.6M). This comes from a stockanalysis.com history table as quoted in search results, and I could not open the page itself. [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/tsla/history/)
- 2026-08-27: the same table shows open 346.16, high 355.74, low 345.45, close $354.81 (up 2.60%, about 30.1M shares). Forecasts close at 18:00 UTC, which is before the 20:00 UTC market close. So at the deadline the stock was trading intraday and this close was not yet final. The figure comes from one source only. [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/tsla/history/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. Resolution is about 15 trading days after Aug 27.
- In late August the stock was around $345 to $355. That is in the middle of the question's range of $200 to $500.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-27: shares up about 2.6% intraday to about $355 (same source as above). [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/tsla/history/)
- About 2026-08-26: a German outlet ran the headline "Tesla stock holds above $345" in a piece about the China recall and the Nevada robotaxi permit. Another report said solar roof production is ending as the robotaxi push reshapes strategy. [ad-hoc-news](https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/corporate-news/tesla-stock-holds-above-345-as-china-recall-and-nevada-robotaxi-permit/69981973), [ad-hoc-news](https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/corporate-news/tesla-stock-dips-as-robotaxi-push-reshapes-strategy-and-solar-roof/69979201)
- 2026-08-22: Tesla sent invitations for a Cybercab launch event in Austin on 2026-09-03. The Cybercab is a two-seat car with no steering wheel or pedals. [Not a Tesla App](https://notateslaapp.com/news/4600/tesla-confirms-date-for-cybercab-event-sends-out-invites), [Motor1](https://www.motor1.com/news/805874/tesla-cybercab-robotaxi-launch-austin/)
- 2026-08-21: Nevada approved up to 5,000 Tesla robotaxis in Clark County, replacing an earlier cap of 10 vehicles. Tesla also launched its Semi in Europe. The stock rose about 4 to 6% intraday, to roughly $358 to $365. On the same day China ordered a recall of about 2.98M vehicles over emergency door releases, Tesla's largest ever. [247wallst](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/08/21/tesla-rallies-4-on-europe-semi-launch-and-las-vegas-robotaxi-permits-uber-ticks-up/), [TIKR](https://www.tikr.com/blog/china-recalled-3-million-teslas-heres-what-it-means)
- 2026-08-19: shares rose about 3% ahead of the Cybercab event (from search summaries).
- 2026-07-22/23: Q2 2026 results. Revenue was $28.24B, beating the $25.71B consensus, but adjusted EPS was $0.33 against about $0.51 expected. Higher capex guidance added pressure, and the stock fell about 14% to 15% on July 23 to an 11-month low. Reports put July's total decline at about 26%, with prices near $304 to $308 in late July. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/article/tesla-tumbles-14-to-11-month-low-as-profit-miss-capex-spending-outlook-weighs-on-stock-110300122.html), [cryptobriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/tesla-stock-plunges-july-earnings-miss/), [tradersunion](https://tradersunion.com/news/stocks/show/2834596-tesla-drops-0-8percent-to-usd304-19/)
- 2026-07-02: shares fell about 7.5% even though Q2 deliveries were better than expected. [iTiger](https://www.itiger.com/news/2649986018)

## 4. Base rates and volatility
- Trend: from a late-July low around $304 to $308, the stock recovered about 15% by Aug 27 to roughly $345 to $355. Before earnings it had been in the $370s.
- TSLA usually moves a lot day to day. Moves of 3% to 7% happened often in July and August 2026, and there was one drop of about 15%.
- My own estimate, not from a source: assuming annualized volatility of 50% to 60% over about 14 to 15 trading days, a one-standard-deviation move is roughly 12% to 14%. From about $350, that means about ±$45 to $50. A two-standard-deviation band of roughly $260 to $450 would still fall inside the question's range.
- Event pattern: past Tesla product or robotaxi events (for example October 2024) were often followed by "sell the news" drops, but this is not consistent.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on TSLA's price for mid-September 2026, and no options implied-volatility snapshot from August 2026.
- Analyst consensus 12-month targets of about $410 have been reported, but the only source I found is dated after the cutoff, so I would not rely on it. I found no pre-cutoff consensus figure that I could confirm.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-03: Cybercab launch event in Austin. It is invite-only and expected to be livestreamed, and it is the main catalyst before resolution. [Motor1](https://www.motor1.com/news/805874/tesla-cybercab-robotaxi-launch-austin/)
- Early September: possible start of Las Vegas robotaxi service under the Nevada permits. Also follow-up on the China recall.
- About 2026-09-10/11: August CPI release (date assumed from the usual schedule).
- 2026-09-15/16: FOMC meeting. The rate decision lands one day before resolution (date assumed from the usual schedule).
- Monthly China and Europe sales and registration data for August come out in early September. China sales were reported down 32% year on year in July.
- Q3 deliveries (early October) and quadruple witching (Sept 18) both fall after resolution.
